trigger: Arrival at Galena's gate (v1 gap: gate scene). Install the control cards if not done.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The fence. The gate. Steam rising out of the dark like breath. Somebody inside has a lantern.

nodes.speaker: pete_lund
nodes.text: WHO GOES— Pearce? PEARCE! Open the gate! It's the mechanic! He brought half of Sparks!

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Nobody inside. Snow drifted in the control room door. Cold as the river.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Rack two, slots four through nine. Pumps, then fans, then the turbine. Your hands know it now.

nodes.speaker: walt
nodes.text: [From the sled, barely a whisper] ...There it is. Hear it? That's... the only good sound...

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Walt Okada dies with the turbine whining up to speed, smiling, his hand on the control room window.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The turbine whines up to speed. The lights come on. Thirty people laugh and cry at once.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: Names. Everybody. Line up by the door. I'm writing everybody down. Everybody.
